examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The same moment in each format: local time, UTC, a relative phrase and the time alone (for a row under a date header). Activate one to open the panel with UTC, local, relative and raw values, each with a copy button.

examples.name: Time zone
examples.summary: A time zone picker bound to the provider's `time-zone`: changing it changes every local time below at once, and the panel adds your browser's time when the zones differ.

examples.name: Log details
examples.summary: Timestamps in the details panel of one request, beside its status code, where people copy the exact UTC value into a query.
